findings.requirement: Plating thickness is allowed for on tight fits and threads
findings.comment: The drawing specifies a tight ISO fit (H7) on dimension D14 and a surface treatment (IZBP) in the title block, but there is no note indicating that the plating thickness has been allowed for in the hole size or that the hole should be machined after plating. This risks the plated part failing to assemble with its mating component.
findings.recommended_correction: Add a note specifying that the H7 tolerance applies after plating, or adjust the pre-plate dimension to account for the specified plating thickness.
